verdict.rationale: Fathom generates AI summaries, action items, coaching scorecards, and Deal View insights directly from meeting data (docs-13,14,28,40), and surfaces this data conversationally via an official MCP server connected to ChatGPT/Claude (docs-10,19,35, probe-rt-1), confirmed live at runtime. Missing for 10: independent third-party review of insight quality/accuracy and more detail on how suggestions surface in-app beyond summaries/action items.
